findings.es_sentence: Pholidosaurus asemejaba al gárido moderno tanto en su aspecto como en su tamaño general.
findings.problem: 'gárido' is not a word; the gharial is 'gavial' in Spanish, and the verb needs 'se' ('se asemejaba').
findings.correct: Pholidosaurus se asemejaba al gavial actual tanto en su aspecto como en su tamaño.

findings.en_sentence: Early descriptions noted that the eye socket was slightly smaller than the supratemporal fossa, the nasal bone extended to the premaxilla, and the vomer was present on the palate.
findings.problem: Source cites a single early description (Lydekker 1888), not several 'early descriptions'.
findings.correct: An early description by Lydekker (1888) noted that...

findings.es_sentence: Las primeras descripciones señalaron que la órbita era ligeramente más pequeña que la fosa supratemporal, el hueso nasal se extendía hasta la premaxilar y el vómer estaba presente en el paladar.
findings.problem: 'la premaxilar' is wrong gender (el hueso premaxilar); also plural 'primeras descripciones' where the source has one description (Lydekker 1888).
findings.correct: Una de las primeras descripciones (Lydekker, 1888) señaló que ... el nasal llegaba hasta el premaxilar...

findings.en_sentence: The individual represented by the type mold was estimated to be around 25 cm in length.
findings.es_sentence: El ejemplar representado por el molde tipo se estimó en unos 25 cm de longitud.
findings.problem: The 'type mold' is never introduced (it is a natural mould of part of a thorax, IMGPGö 741-1), and a 25 cm individual flatly contradicts the gharial-sized animal stated in the description; the 25 cm figure plausibly refers to the size of the thoracic mould, not of the whole animal.
findings.correct: Introduce the holotype as a natural mould of part of the thorax (IMGPGö 741-1, found c. 1830 in the Obernkirchen Sandstone) and do not present 25 cm as the animal's body length, or explain the discrepancy.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Species; eswiki Especies; F005, F016, F003; knowledge

findings.en_sentence: Macrorhynchus is a more modern synonym of Pholidosaurus, named in 1843 from the Wealden in southern England with the type species M. meyeri.
findings.es_sentence: Macrorhynchus es un sinónimo más reciente de Pholidosaurus, establecido en 1843 desde el Wealden del sur de Inglaterra, con M. meyeri como especie tipo.
findings.problem: Macrorhynchus meyeri was named (Dunker, 1843/1844) from the north German Wealden, the same unit and region as P. schaumburgensis, not from southern England (eswiki error).
findings.correct: Macrorhynchus, a junior synonym of Pholidosaurus, was named in 1843 from the Wealden of northern Germany, with the type species M. meyeri.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Species ('same stratigraphic unit and region as P. schaumbergensis'); Dunker 1844 'norddeutschen Wealden'; F018

findings.en_sentence: Macrorhynchus is a more modern synonym of Pholidosaurus, named in 1843 from the Wealden in southern England with the type species M. meyeri.
findings.problem: 'more modern synonym' is a literal back-translation of 'sinónimo más moderno'; the English term is 'junior synonym'.
findings.correct: Macrorhynchus is a junior synonym of Pholidosaurus...

findings.en_sentence: The genus Macrorhynchus is considered a junior synonym of Pholidosaurus.
findings.es_sentence: El género Macrorhynchus se considera un sinónimo posterior de Pholidosaurus.
findings.problem: Repeats the synonymy already stated in the discovery section.
findings.correct: Drop one of the two sentences.

findings.en_sentence: The holotype is an almost complete skull named DORCM G97, which lacks the anterior part of the face.
findings.es_sentence: El holotipo es un cráneo casi completo denominado DORCM G97, que carece de la parte anterior del rostro.
findings.problem: DORCM G97 is the holotype of P. purbeckensis (originally Steneosaurus purbeckensis, 1888), not of Pholidosaurus; the genus's type is the thoracic mould of P. schaumburgensis. The page also never introduces P. purbeckensis here.
findings.correct: The holotype of P. purbeckensis, originally described as Steneosaurus purbeckensis in 1888, is an almost complete skull (DORCM G97) lacking the front of the snout.

findings.en_sentence: Pholidosaurus has recently been reassigned to the family Pholidosauridae, along with the genera Elosuchus, Sarcosuchus, and Terminonaris.
findings.problem: Contradicts the earlier sentence that Pholidosaurus is the type genus of Pholidosauridae: the type genus cannot be 'reassigned' to its own family; the eswiki wording is outdated.
findings.correct: Pholidosauridae also includes genera such as Elosuchus, Sarcosuchus and Terminonaris.

findings.en_sentence: Buckley and Brochu (1999) concluded that Pholidosaurus formed a long-snouted clade that was the sister group to Crocodylia.
findings.problem: Pholidosaurus alone cannot form a clade; the source says Pholidosaurus, Sokotosuchus, Dyrosauridae and Thalattosuchia together formed the longirostrine clade.
findings.correct: Buckley and Brochu (1999) found that Pholidosaurus, Sokotosuchus, dyrosaurids and thalattosuchians formed a long-snouted clade, the sister group of Crocodylia.

findings.es_sentence: Buckley y Brochu (1999) concluyeron que Pholidosaurus formaba un clado de hocico largo que constituía el grupo hermano de los cocodrilomorfos.
findings.problem: Sister group of Crocodylia (crocodilios), not of 'cocodrilomorfos'; Pholidosaurus is itself a crocodylomorph, so the Spanish is false. Also has the same 'Pholidosaurus alone forms a clade' problem.
findings.correct: Buckley y Brochu (1999) concluyeron que Pholidosaurus, Sokotosuchus, los dirosáuridos y los talatosuquios formaban un clado de hocico largo, grupo hermano de Crocodylia.

findings.en_sentence: Recent studies indicate that Thalattosuchia is a more basal lineage when dyrosaurids are excluded from the analysis.
findings.es_sentence: Estudios recientes indican que la Thalattosuchia es una línea más basal cuando se excluyen los dyrosáuridos del análisis.
findings.problem: 'More basal' than what is left unstated; the sentence only makes sense as a rebuttal of the Buckley & Brochu long-snouted clade (convergence in snout characters).
findings.correct: Later studies found that, once dyrosaurids are removed from the data set, thalattosuchians fall outside this group as a more basal lineage, suggesting the long-snouted clade reflected convergence.

findings.es_sentence: Estudios recientes indican que la Thalattosuchia es una línea más basal cuando se excluyen los dyrosáuridos del análisis.
findings.problem: 'la Thalattosuchia' with article and 'dyrosáuridos' with English spelling; Spanish uses 'Thalattosuchia' without article (or 'los talatosuquios') and 'dirosáuridos'.
findings.correct: Estudios recientes indican que los talatosuquios forman un linaje más basal cuando se excluyen los dirosáuridos del análisis.

findings.en_sentence: A 2002 study determined that Steneosaurus purbeckensis is the same species as Pholidosaurus decipiens, resulting in the combination Pholidosaurus purbeckensis.
findings.es_sentence: Un estudio de 2002 determinó que Steneosaurus purbeckensis es la misma especie que Pholidosaurus decipiens, dando lugar a la combinación Pholidosaurus purbeckensis.
findings.problem: Steneosaurus purbeckensis and Pholidosaurus decipiens are never introduced on the page.
findings.correct: Briefly introduce P. decipiens (for NHMUK 28432, ex-Petrosuchus laevidens) and S. purbeckensis (Mansel-Pleydell 1888).

findings.en_sentence: Smith et al. (2016) suggested that Pholidosaurus purbeckensis is not closely related to the type species but is instead related to Fortignathus and Dyrosauridae.
findings.es_sentence: Smith y colaboradores (2016) sugirieron que Pholidosaurus purbeckensis no está estrechamente emparentado con la especie tipo, sino que lo está con Fortignathus y los Dyrosauridae.
findings.problem: Source says P. purbeckensis is 'not congeneric' with the type species (an SVPCA conference abstract); 'not closely related' overstates it, and presenting an abstract as an established suggestion without noting it is an abstract.
findings.correct: In a conference abstract, Smith et al. (2016) argued that P. purbeckensis does not belong in the same genus as the type species and is instead close to Fortignathus and dyrosaurids.

findings.es_sentence: Jouve y otros (2006) concluyeron que Pholidosaurus era un folidosaurido, aunque en su análisis filogenético incluyeron a los talatósucios en la familia, lo que podría considerarse parafilético sin ellos.
findings.problem: 'talatósucios' is not the Spanish term ('talatosuquios'); 'folidosaurido' lacks the accent ('folidosáurido'); 'lo que podría considerarse parafilético sin ellos' changes the referent (it is the family that would be paraphyletic).
findings.correct: ...concluyeron que Pholidosaurus era un folidosáurido, aunque en su análisis incluyeron a los talatosuquios en la familia, que sin ellos resultaría parafilética.

findings.en_sentence: The genus lived from the Tithonian to the Aptian, between 149.2 and 113.2 million years ago.
findings.es_sentence: El género existió desde el titoniense hasta el aptiense, hace entre 149,2 y 113,2 millones de años.
findings.problem: Repeats verbatim the Tithonian–Aptian range already given in the previous sentence.
findings.correct: Drop the second sentence.

findings.es_sentence: Pholidosaurus vivió durante los pisos berriasiense a albiense del Cretácico Inferior, mientras que otras estimaciones sugieren que el género habitó desde el titoniense hasta el aptiense, entre hace 149,2 y 113,2 millones de años.
findings.problem: Stage names should be capitalized in Spanish (Berriasiense, Albiense, Titoniense, Aptiense); 'entre hace 149,2 y 113,2' is awkward ('hace entre').
findings.correct: ...durante los pisos Berriasiense a Albiense del Cretácico Inferior, ... desde el Titoniense hasta el Aptiense, hace entre 149,2 y 113,2 millones de años.

findings.en_sentence: P. meyeri differs from the type species P. schaumburgensis in that the bony bar separating the supratemporal fenestra is rounded, whereas in the type species it is round.
findings.problem: 'rounded, whereas in the type species it is round' is meaningless (eswiki error); in the type species the bar is angular.
findings.correct: P. meyeri differs from P. schaumburgensis in that the bar separating the supratemporal fenestrae is rounded, whereas in the type species it is angular.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Species ('while in the type species it is angular'); F019

findings.en_sentence: Because the name S. purbeckensis had priority over P. decipiens but not the genus Pholidosaurus, the name Pholidosaurus purbeckensis is considered to have priority.
findings.problem: Garbled reasoning: the epithet purbeckensis (1888) is older than decipiens, so it takes priority within Pholidosaurus; 'had priority over ... but not the genus' is incoherent to a reader.
findings.correct: Because the species name purbeckensis (1888) is older than decipiens, the combined species is called Pholidosaurus purbeckensis.

findings.en_sentence: It was considered a more modern synonym of P. purbeckensis by both Salisbury et al. (1999) and Salisbury (2002).
findings.es_sentence: Fue considerado un sinónimo más reciente de P. purbeckensis tanto por Salisbury y colaboradores (1999) como por Salisbury (2002).
findings.problem: 'It' has no antecedent: the subject is P. laevis (Andrews 1913, NHMUK R3414), which the page never mentions; EN also uses the calque 'more modern synonym' for 'junior synonym'.
findings.correct: P. laevis, named in 1913 from a partial skull from Swanage, was considered a junior synonym of P. purbeckensis by Salisbury et al. (1999) and Salisbury (2002).

findings.es_sentence: Barbini y otros (2026) informaron de pruebas que la anatomía endocranial de P. purbeckensis es más similar a la de los goniófilidos que a la de los dyrosáuridos, y encontraron posibles correlatos osteológicos de las glándulas salinas nasales.
findings.problem: 'goniófilidos' is wrong ('goniofolídidos'), 'dyrosáuridos' should be 'dirosáuridos', 'endocranial' should be 'endocraneal', and 'pruebas que' needs 'de que'.
findings.correct: Barbini y colaboradores (2026) aportaron indicios de que la anatomía endocraneal de P. purbeckensis se parece más a la de los goniofolídidos que a la de los dirosáuridos, y hallaron posibles correlatos osteológicos de glándulas de sal nasales.

findings.es_sentence: Fue considerado un sinónimo más reciente de P. purbeckensis tanto por Salisbury y colaboradores (1999) como por Salisbury (2002).
findings.problem: Spanish page omits the EN sentences on Pholidosauridae membership, P. meyeri vs P. schaumburgensis and the purbeckensis priority, so the debate section opens with an unanchored 'Fue considerado'.
findings.correct: Align the ES debate section with EN or give the sentence an explicit subject (P. laevis).
